title: Universaarl Number Series Lines route recovery

successCriteria: Before screenshot shows U-* number-series header rows visible.
Line page screenshots show Startnr. and Endnr. values for each target series or exact blocked editor reason.
Result separates number-series line setup from later setup-field assignments.
No master data, draft, preview posting, posting or ledger trace occurs.
